title: Google's New AI Feels Like the Future
description:
Google just introduced Dreambeans, an experimental AI app that creates personalized daily stories based on your interests, activities, and connected Google apps.

Instead of endless scrolling, Dreambeans uses AI to surface ideas, recommendations, and insights that actually matter to you.

This could be one of Google's most personal AI experiences yet.
transcript: What if your phone started creating a personalized magazine about your life every morning instead of social media feeds? Google just revealed something called Dream Beans. Instead of scrolling through hundreds of posts, emails, videos, and notifications, Dream Beans uses AI to connect information from apps like Gmail, Calendar, Photos, YouTube, and Search. Then it creates a small collection of personalized stories designed specifically for you. Imagine you have a flight coming up next week. Dream Beans notices the flight confirmation in your Gmail, sees the destination in your calendar, and creates a story with local attractions, weather tips, and places you might want to visit. Every story even comes with its own AI-generated illustration using Nano Banana 2. Follow for more AI updates like this.
